trip_meta.theme: car-friendly weekend focused on top-rated ice cream scoops plus must-see sights

recommendations.name: Sweet Jesus
recommendations.reason: Over‑the‑top soft‑serve cones and Instagram‑worthy combos; great downtown starter since it opens earlier than many scoop shops.

recommendations.name: St. Lawrence Market
recommendations.reason: Historic market for a morning wander/food stalls before ice cream. (Open mornings; good parking nearby).

recommendations.name: CN Tower
recommendations.reason: Iconic skyline/viewpoint if you want a sight between downtown stops.

recommendations.name: Bang Bang Ice Cream & Bakery
recommendations.reason: Famous for creative housemade flavors and legendary ice‑cream sandwiches — a weekend must for unique combos. (Expect lines; opens midday.)

recommendations.name: Trinity Bellwoods Park
recommendations.reason: Chill park for a short break between Queen‑West shops.

recommendations.name: Death in Venice Gelato Co.
recommendations.reason: Award‑winning, wildly creative gelato flavors and rotating menu — excellent craft gelato on Dundas West.

recommendations.name: Ruru Baked
recommendations.reason: Small‑batch, custard‑style scoops with adventurous flavours (hojicha, banoffee, durian rotations) — great for tasting flights.

recommendations.name: Casa Loma
recommendations.reason: If you want a photo stop/quick tour near the Annex before or after Dutch Dreams.

recommendations.name: Dutch Dreams
recommendations.reason: Nostalgic favourite known for elaborate cones/toppings; good late‑night option.

recommendations.name: Ed’s Real Scoop (Beaches)
recommendations.address: Beaches: 2224 Queen St E; Leslieville: 920 Queen St E
recommendations.reason: Classic Toronto institution — iconic Burnt Marshmallow flavour and generous scoops; essential Beaches stop.

recommendations.name: Kawartha Dairy (Danforth)
recommendations.reason: Trusted Ontario creamery with big portions and classic flavours — good East‑end pit stop.

recommendations.name: Scarborough Bluffs
recommendations.address: Beaches/Scarborough Bluffs (e.g., Bluffer's Park), 1 Brimley Rd S
recommendations.reason: Spectacular lakeshore cliffs — perfect scenic finish to a beach‑and‑ice‑cream weekend.
